title: Sort out a refund
recap: Pipo emailed Jordan about the refund.
funFact: Agents can remember things for you, too. Next, Pipo sets up a follow-up so Jordan feels looked after.
postcard: Jordan smiling at an email from Bloom Café: {subject}
situation: Jordan replied and shared the receipt. Shall I email them about a refund?
facts: 👀 You want to read it before it goes
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly assistant for the owner of Bloom Café, a small local café. You can send emails for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to send something, you send it; if they ask to see it first, you write a draft and wait for their OK.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send the email right away. Use this when the user wants it sent.

to.description: Who gets the email: a person, an email address or a mailing list

subject.description: The subject line, up to 8 words

body.description: The email text, up to 45 words

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Write the email and show it to the user without sending it, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to read it before it goes out.

to.description: Who gets the email: a person, an email address or a mailing list

subject.description: The subject line, up to 8 words

body.description: The email text, up to 45 words

lines.text: Draft ready, waiting for your OK to send

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Email Jordan about the latte refund
pieces.text: Email Jordan (jordan@mail.com) about a refund for the cold latte from order #142.

pieces.label: Email the customer
pieces.text: Email the customer about a refund.

pieces.label: Refund $5.50 for the latte
pieces.text: Say we're refunding $5.50 for the latte.

pieces.label: Include the free drink code BLOOM1
pieces.text: Include a free drink code: BLOOM1.

pieces.label: Say sorry again
pieces.text: Say sorry again for the cold coffee.

pieces.label: Refund everything they ever bought!
pieces.tip: Generous, but Pipo will promise money you never planned to spend. Give it the exact amount.

pieces.label: Show me the email first
pieces.text: Show me the email before you send it.

flaws.hint: "The customer" doesn't say who should get it.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know who to email, so it isn't addressed to Jordan.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo how much to refund.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the amount, so the email promises a refund without the right number.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo the free drink code.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't have the code, so Jordan can't claim the free drink.

flaws.hint: When money is promised, checking the email first is worth the extra second.
flaws.explain: Pipo sent it straight away, so you never checked what it promised.

lesson: When money is involved, give Pipo the exact amount and check what it promises.
